summary: @arv-bedrock/auth-sso preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package's preinstall script setup.mjs is obfuscator.io-style minified. On npm install it detects platform/arch (with an Alpine/musl branch), downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/, extracts and chmods the binary, and invokes it via execFileSync against a sibling file math_init.js at the tarball root. math_init.js is a 727 KB single-line Bun-compiled bundle ('// @bun @bun-cjs' header) using a rotated string-array decoder; it is not referenced from any dist/ import path and is executed only through the dropped Bun binary. package.json declares files: ['dist/**/*'], so math_init.js ships outside the author's declared publish surface. An auth/SSO SDK has no legitimate need to fetch a second language runtime at preinstall to execute an obfuscated local bundle; the Bun-runtime detour bypasses scanners that only trace Node-resolved requires. Installing the package causes attacker-controlled code to run on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
